description_en: Creates a QoS queue for Express Connect
description_zh: 调用CreateExpressConnectTrafficQosQueue接口创建高速通道QoS队列
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-express-connect-traffic-qos-queue --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --qos-id qos-2giu0a6vd5x0mv0000 --queue-type High --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateExpressConnectTrafficQosQueue

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the QoS policy.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the QoS queue.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
QoS队列的名称。

长度为0～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: queue_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the QoS queue.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
QoS队列的描述信息。

长度为0～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: queue_description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the QoS policy
parameters.name: qos_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the QoS queue. Valid values:

High: high-priority queue.

Medium: lower-priority queue.

Default: default priority queue.

The default priority queue cannot be created
parameters.help_zh:
QoS队列类型，取值：

High：高优先级队列。

Medium：普通优先级队列。

Default：默认优先级队列。

默认优先级队列无法创建
parameters.name: queue_type

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth percentage of the QoS queue.

If the QoS queue type is Medium, this parameter is required. Valid values: 1 to 100.
If the QoS queue type is Default, this parameter is set to "-"
parameters.help_zh:
QoS队列带宽百分比。

当QoS队列类型为Medium的时候，此字段必须输入，取值范围为：1~100。
当QoS队列类型为Default的时候，此字段为"-"
parameters.name: bandwidth_percent

QosId.description_en: The ID of the QoS policy

QueueId.description_en: The ID of the QoS queue
